comparison.candidate_rule: distance <= candidate_max_distance flags a possible acoustic relation for audit only; it never establishes recording identity by itself
comparison.confirmed_group_rule: non-exact assets may share split protection only when distance <= confirmed_group_max_distance AND decoded sample-count relative delta <= confirmed_group_max_relative_sample_count_delta
comparison.transitive_rule: only exact byte/PCM identity and confirmed grouping edges participate in connected-component closure; review-only screening edges never union components

fixture_gate.pass_rule: all transformed-copy fixtures <= confirmed_group_max_distance with compatible decoded duration AND all known-independent fixtures > candidate_max_distance

certification_boundary: This policy is a leakage-screening mechanism, not acoustic identity truth. Exact SHA-256 remains byte identity. The broad candidate threshold produces review evidence only. Split-protection grouping requires exact byte/PCM identity or a separately confirmed near-duplicate edge satisfying both the strict distance and decoded-length constraints. No grouping decision authorizes content merge or deletion.
